sentences.text: The known remains include three well-preserved but incomplete dorsal vertebrae.
Scientists estimate this animal reached a length of 18 meters and a mass of 13.5 tonnes.
Fossils were found in the Anacleto Formation of Neuquén province, western Argentina.
The genus name Barrosasaurus honors the Sierra Barrosa in Neuquén.
The specific epithet casamiquelai honors the Argentinian paleontologist Rodolfo Magín Casamiquela.
Barrosasaurus belongs to the parent group Titanosauria.
It is classified in the class Saurischia.
This creature lived from the Turonian to the Campanian stages, between 93.9 and 72.2 million years ago.
